newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle trade slow at $67-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle trade slow at $67-USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area Monday, USDA said. Limited test slaughter steers and heifers steady.
Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 2,400 slaughter steers and 300 heifers; 5,500 head confirmed for the week to date.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 67.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 67.00.
Confirmed - 2,700 Week ago - None Year ago - None
Wk to Date - 5,500 Week ago - 1,200 Year ago - 4,400
